description: Before a Datashard save or flag, checks the project's DATASHARD.md names the same install

hooks.command: sh -c 'f=$1; d() { cat >/dev/null; printf "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"The Datashard save check was blocked: %s\"}}\n" "$1"; exit 0; }; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || d "node is not on PATH. Install Node.js, then try again."; [ -f "$f" ] || d "the plugin file scripts/codex-check-install.mjs is missing. Reinstall the Datashard plugin."; node "$f" || d "the check itself failed to run.";' sh "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/codex-check-install.mjs"
hooks.statusMessage: Checking this save belongs to the project's Datashard
